title: This pepper mill needs improvement
text:
This pepper mill needs improvement. This pepper mill is not only for wealthy consumers looking for another way to spend their money. It can be a medical aid in some cases for those with hand problems. I have no objection to a high-priced automatic pepper mill because those who have hand problems (arthritis, carpel tunnel, one arm or hand, etc.) will find it possible to now grind pepper and coriander without difficulty or pain. After all I purchased a $200 [[ASIN:B000A76VCY Breville 800CPXL Die-Cast Stainless-Steel Motorized Citrus Press]] just to reduce the hand stress I was experiencing with squeezing lemons and limes which I absolutely love and believe it was money well spent.

However, this pepper mill is not in the same league. I expected an elite "machine" that worked simply and well and here's what I got.

In the box is one large pepper mill that is mostly all motor. It comes with a small container of peppercorns and what looks like a square base on which the pepper mill should rest when not in use. (NOTE - It slips easily off this base if that is what it was designed for.) There are also 6 AAA batteries included.

The pepper mill has to be disassembled to load the peppercorns and also to extract the motor and load the batteries. Extracting the motor was incredibly cumbersome. There are 2 sliding levers on the inside plate that have to be shifted toward the inside of the motor with a pencil or file. In the process, my levers bent and almost broke off (so they are shoddy levers). Once the levers are no longer holding the motor in place, the unit has to be lightly shaken to dislodge the motor. It took a while for it to dislodge. Once the motor is removed, the batteries were easy to insert and the direction of insertion (negative and positive) were clearly marked.

After battery installation, I had to reverse the entire process. Inserting the motor is tricky as well as I had to line up certain parts, then push down the motor, and re-seat the levers out and under the base lip.

The top of the vessel holding the peppercorns that came with this product also acts also like funnel. I had to unscrew the top and punch out the center piece then lay this over the peppercorn reservoir to fill it. Once that was done. I screwed the holder to the base. (NOTE - Save the container that came with the peppercorns because it is a measuring cup for refilling the reservoir.)

As per the manual, only black, white, and green (dry) peppercorns of 5 mm (0.2") or less should be used in this mill for optimal performance. It also grinds pink peppercorns as long as the pink ones are no more than 15% of the peppercorns being ground. In addition, it grinds dry coriander seeds.

There are six (6) gradations of grind (from fine to coarse) marked on the bottom dial. Based on my tests (since the instructions are not clear on this), it appears the single horizontal line indicates a fine grind and as the lines increase in number to six (6) lines that indicates a coarser grind. The grind level is set by turning the dial to line up the desired grind lines with the letter P written on the reservoir (which is difficult to see).

To dispense the pepper, I just lightly touched the "button" on the top of the base to activate the motor. A light comes on and then dispenses the pepper according to the grind level set. The mill grinds quickly and well. Since the unit engages the motor easily, it means if one of my cats touches the top, the pepper will also grind.

In summary, had I paid for this product, I would have sent it back for a refund. The batteries are too difficult to get to, the levers holding the motor in place are poor quality and easily broken, there is no shutoff for the motor once the batteries are installed so the slightest touch of the button grinds pepper, and it does not feel like the elite "machine" I expected. Also, the lifetime warranty is on the motor only and no other part. If this grinder came with USB or other rechargeable and easy to insert batteries, had the ability to turn off the motor, felt like a quality kitchen tool, and the instructions were clearer (five languages follow each instruction) then I would have given this 5 stars. As it stands now, I consider this a working prototype only and not a kitchen tool that should be sold for such a high price.

product_metadata.title: Peugeot Elis Sense U-Select Set Salt & Pepper Mill, Large, brushed nickel
features: EFFORTLESS MILLS — With a single touch, the Elis Sense u'Select electric mills light up to deliver freshly ground spices. Just touch the body and the top to start the mechanism. When technology supports gastronomy, it is pure pleasure! Developed in France by Peugeot

U’SELECT SETTINGS — Our patented system helps you select your desired grind. Twist to create your precise balance of flavor through six settings, from extra fine to very coarse. The two-stage grinding mechanism first effortlessly cracks and then grinds the peppercorns and salt to the desired coarseness

PRECISION GRIND — Through two centuries of experience, we have expertly engineered each mill and mechanism specifically for the consistency and shape of peppercorns and salt crystals. Make sure to fill each one with the correct spice for optimum use. We make the gears at our French factory from stainless steel that is treated to prevent corrosion and rust

ENHANCE FLAVOR — The u’Select mechanism brings out the depth of each seasoning by selecting the right grind for your taste. Salt makes meat juicier, and balances other flavors. Finely ground pepper will bring out its spice, while a coarser grind intensifies the flavor. Find your Peugeot moment and enjoy the art of French living with our instruments of taste

READY TO SEASON — Our salt mills come with Cristaux de sel blanc d'Allemagne, a dry white rock salt from Germany, and our pepper mills with Tan Hoi black pepper from Vietnam (refill cubes are available from Peugeot). Fill with dry rock salt only (max size smaller than 1/6 inch/4mm) — do not use sea salt, and max size ¼-inch (6mm) peppercorns

MILLED STEEL — Elis Sense mills mechanisms are made in France from case hardened steel and stainless steel. Each product is a marriage of ingenuity and elegance, designed so that the brushed finish and straight lines give off exceptional style in your home. Comes with six AAA batteries. To replace, remove the top section and unlock the motor from its housing
description: Peugeot Mills, a combination of design and ingenuity. Since 1840, Peugeot Mills have been an essential benchmark for gourmets and great chefs alike. They are exceptional pieces that have become tableware icons, from coffee mills to salt, pepper or spice grinders, manual or electric. Peugeot Mills are a pleasure to use with their sleek and elegant design, their noble indestructible materials, their range of shapes and colors and their ever-more-innovative mechanisms, with a lifetime guarantee. A wide range of Peugeot Mills so you can get the best from each product. All our mills are instruments of taste designed with a single goal: to extract the most perfect texture, grind and flavor possible, in the search for a delicious sensory experience. An aromatic journey through the world of the senses, an invitation to culinary excellence with a decidedly modern and contemporary approach, reflecting the perception of what is the French art of living today.
